page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head across the top; a centred subheading and a marginal roman numeral "IX." at the left of the lower paragraph; a catchword "Cap." at the lower right.

main_text.p: mere per accidens; as proinde nimis infra Sacramenti dignitatem. Sed etiam QVIA IPSA ILLA CELEBRATIO SIT ACTVS RELIGIOSVS: AC PROINDE SEPARARI NEQVEAT AB ADORATIONE CHRISTI: sicut oratio, hymnus, & similia. Unde etiam Eucharistias nomen. Nam QVICVNQVE PIVS AGIT GRATIAS DEO, IDEM ADORAT DEVM. §. 11. Sed Papistae non sic: imo secundo modo: unde ratio illa loquendi, ADORARE SACRAMENTVM, ADORARE EVCHARISTIAM: quod profecto alias nunquam dicerent, quomodo non dicunt se adorare suas Letanias. Sed quomodo adorant DEVM in imaginibus: quia has primo; deinde per relationem, DEVM; & sic Gregorius de Valentia dixit, qui censeant nullo modo ad species ipsas eam venerationem pertinere, in eo Haereticè pugnare contra perpetuum usum & sensum Ecclesiae.
main_text.head: Idem eodem Lib. cap. 2. §. 9.
main_text.p: IX. Adorabimus in loco ubi steterunt pedes ejus. Bene; adorare in loco: at non adorare locum. Sic nos facile, ADORAMVS IN EVCHARISTIA, sed NON ADORAMVS EVCHARISTIAM.

page.notes: Marginal "IX." is a section number in the left margin. The "§. 11." is set in the right margin beside the paragraph. Printed page number "358" is partly smudged; read as 358. Greek and black letter: none. Some ink show-through in the lower half, not transcribed.
